crossRefs.note: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone…
Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever…
The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert…
After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

parallels.note: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
translations.bsb: When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.
translations.kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
translations.asv: Now when Jesus heard it, he withdrew from thence in a boat, to a desert place apart: and when the multitudes heard thereof, they followed him on foot from the cities.
